articles.summary: NDA submission based on the Phase 2b REZILIENT1 clinical trial, which demonstrated clinically meaningful and durable responses in patients with relapsed EGFR exon 20 insertion–mutated NSCLC Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date is February 27, 2027 PRINCETON, New Jersey, TOKYO,
articles.title: U.S. Food and Drug Administration Accepts New Drug Application for Zipalertinib for the Treatment of Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer with EGFR Exon 20 Insertion Mutations
